text: Onions and garlic, finely chopped and browned in medium heat, unlock the full potential of your dishes by releasing their rich flavors. As they cook, they develop a depth that captivates the senses. To further enhance their aroma, season them with a pinch of salt to bring out their natural sweetness and a generous grind of pepper to add a subtle warmth. Spices such as thyme, rosemary, or paprika can be added for a more aromatic kick. Once they're golden brown and fragrant, their flavors will be intensified, making them a fundamental component in any culinary creation.
summary: Onions and garlic, finely chopped and browned in medium heat, release flavors; season with salt, pepper, and spices.
